name: Awakened Shrub
special_abilities: False Appearance: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.
actions: Rake: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4-1) slashing.
description: An awakened shrub is a normal shrub given sentience and mobility.

name: Baboon
special_abilities: Pack Tactics: The baboon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4-1) piercing.
description: Baboons are opportunistic omnivores that travel in troops.

name: Badger
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing.
description: Badgers are small, burrowing mammals with a fierce temperament.

name: Bat
special_abilities: Echolocation: The bat can't use its blindsight while deafened. Keen Hearing: The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing.
description: Bats are small flying mammals that navigate by echolocation.

name: Cat
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
actions: Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing.
description: Cats are common domestic predators.

name: Crab
special_abilities: Amphibious: The crab can breathe air and water.
actions: Claw: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning.
description: Crabs are small crustaceans found along shores.

name: Deer
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing.
description: Deer are graceful herbivores found in forests and grasslands.

name: Eagle
special_abilities: Keen Sight: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
actions: Talons: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) slashing.
description: Eagles are birds of prey known for their keen eyesight.

name: Frog
special_abilities: Amphibious: The frog can breathe air and water. Standing Leap: The frog's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.
description: Frogs are small amphibians found in watery environments.

name: Giant Fire Beetle
special_abilities: Illumination: The beetle sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6-1) slashing.
description: Giant fire beetles are luminous beetles that dwell in dark places.

name: Giant Rat
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The giant rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. Pack Tactics: The giant rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing.
description: Giant rats are larger, more aggressive versions of common rats, often found in sewers and dungeons.

name: Kobold
special_abilities: Pack Tactics: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated. Sunlight Sensitivity: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
actions: Dagger: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing. Sling: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) bludgeoning.
description: Kobolds are craven, reptilian humanoids that worship dragons.

name: Stirge
actions: Blood Drain: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge drains blood at the start of each of its turns, dealing 5 (1d4+3) damage.
description: Stirges are bat-like creatures that feed on the blood of living creatures.

name: Merfolk
special_abilities: Amphibious: The merfolk can breathe air and water.
actions: Spear: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing.
description: Merfolk are aquatic humanoids with fish-like lower bodies.

name: Poisonous Snake
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing plus 5 (2d4) poison.
description: Small venomous snakes found in a variety of environments.

name: Flying Snake
special_abilities: Flyby: The flying snake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing plus 7 (3d4) poison.
description: Flying snakes are brightly colored serpents with wing-like membranes.

name: Guard Drake
actions: Multiattack: The guard drake makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.
description: Guard drakes are dragon-like creatures bred from dragon eggs.

name: Swarm of Bats
condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned
special_abilities: Echolocation: The swarm can't use its blindsight while deafened. Keen Hearing: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing. Swarm: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.
actions: Bites: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 5 (2d4) piercing.
description: Swarm of bats is a cloud of small flying mammals.

name: Goblin
special_abilities: Nimble Escape: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
actions: Scimitar: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing. Shortbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing.
description: Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that dwell in caves and dark forests.

name: Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
actions: Shortsword: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing. Shortbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing.
description: Skeletons are the animated bones of the dead, bound to the will of necromantic masters.

name: Zombie
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
special_abilities: Undead Fortitude: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with DC 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
actions: Slam: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning.
description: Zombies are mindless reanimated corpses driven by necromantic magic.

name: Wolf
special_abilities: Keen Hearing and Smell: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell. Pack Tactics: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) piercing. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
description: Wolves hunt in packs using coordinated tactics to bring down larger prey.

name: Panther
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The panther has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. Pounce: If the panther moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing. Claw: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) slashing.
description: Panthers are large forest cats that ambush their prey.

name: Axe Beak
actions: Beak: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing.
description: Axe beaks are large, flightless birds with powerful beaks.

name: Blink Dog
special_abilities: Keen Hearing and Smell: The blink dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing.
description: Blink dogs are fey creatures that can teleport short distances.

name: Boar
special_abilities: Charge: If the boar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) slashing damage.
actions: Tusk: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) slashing.
description: Boars are aggressive wild pigs found in forests.

name: Elk
special_abilities: Charge: If the elk moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.
actions: Ram: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) bludgeoning.
description: Elks are majestic herbivores that roam in herds.

name: Swarm of Ravens
condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned
special_abilities: Swarm: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven.
actions: Beaks: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing.
description: A swarm of ravens is a murder of the black birds that attacks as one.

name: Hobgoblin
special_abilities: Martial Advantage: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.
actions: Longsword: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing, or 7 (1d10+2) slashing if used with two hands. Longbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing.
description: Hobgoblins are militaristic humanoids known for their discipline and tactical cunning.

name: Orc
special_abilities: Aggressive: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
actions: Greataxe: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing. Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing.
description: Orcs are savage, brutish humanoids driven by a lust for battle.

name: Ape
actions: Multiattack: The ape makes two fist attacks. Fist: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) bludgeoning.
description: Apes are strong, intelligent primates that dwell in tropical forests.

name: Black Bear
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
actions: Multiattack: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. Bite: +3 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing. Claws: +3 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 6 (2d4+2) slashing.
description: Black bears are omnivorous forest dwellers.

name: Crocodile
special_abilities: Hold Breath: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) piercing. The target is grappled (escape DC 12).
description: Crocodiles are large aquatic reptiles that ambush their prey.

name: Giant Wasp
actions: Sting: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison.
description: Giant wasps are aggressive predators with a venomous sting.

name: Scout
special_abilities: Keen Hearing and Sight: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.
actions: Multiattack: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks. Shortsword: +4 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing. Longbow: +4 to hit, 150/600 ft., Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing.
description: Scouts are skilled hunters and trackers.

name: Shadow
damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
condition_immunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
special_abilities: Amorphous: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Sunlight Weakness: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
actions: Strength Drain: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) necrotic damage and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4.
description: Shadows are undead creatures that drain strength from the living.

name: Worg
special_abilities: Keen Hearing and Smell: The worg has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be knocked prone.
description: Worgs are intelligent, evil wolf-like creatures often ridden by goblins.

name: Dire Wolf
special_abilities: Keen Hearing and Smell: The dire wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell. Pack Tactics: The dire wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
description: Dire wolves are larger, more vicious relatives of common wolves.

name: Specter
damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak
special_abilities: Incorporeal Movement: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. Sunlight Sensitivity: While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.
actions: Life Drain: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken.
description: Specters are restless spirits of the dead bound to the world by unfinished business.

name: Ghoul
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing. Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute.
description: Ghouls are ravenous undead that feast on the corpses of the dead.

name: Brown Bear
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
actions: Multiattack: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. Bite: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 8 (1d8+3) piercing. Claws: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing.
description: Brown bears are massive, powerful omnivores.

name: Harpy
actions: Multiattack: The harpy makes two attacks: one with its club and one with its claws. Club: +3 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning. Claws: +3 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 6 (2d4+1) slashing. Luring Song: The harpy sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom save or be charmed until the song ends.
description: Harpies are cruel winged creatures with the bodies of birds and faces of women.

name: Imp
damage_resistances: cold, fire; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Shapechanger: The imp can polymorph into a rat (speed 20 ft.), raven (speed 20 ft.), or spider (speed 20 ft.) or back. Magical Resistance: The imp has advantage on saves vs. spells.
actions: Sting: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison. Invisible: The imp magically turns invisible.
description: Imps are minor devils that serve as familiars and spies.

name: Lion
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The lion has advantage on Perception checks relying on smell. Pack Tactics: The lion has advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 ft. Pounce: If the lion moves 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits with a claw attack, the target must make a DC 13 Strength save or be knocked prone.
actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing. Claw: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing.
description: Lions are powerful predators that hunt in prides.

name: Giant Spider
special_abilities: Spider Climb: The spider can climb difficult surfaces. Web Sense: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any creature touching the same web. Web Walker: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing plus 11 (2d8+2) poison. Web: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: restrained by webbing (escape DC 12).
description: Giant spiders are massive arachnids that trap prey in webs.

name: Tiger
special_abilities: Keen Smell: Advantage on Perception checks relying on smell. Pounce: If the tiger moves 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits with a claw attack, the target makes a DC 13 Strength save or is knocked prone.
actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing. Claw: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing.
description: Tigers are solitary apex predators found in forests and jungles.

name: Gelatinous Cube
condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, stunned, unconscious
special_abilities: Ooze Cube: The cube takes up its entire space. Transparent: Even when in plain sight, it takes a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot it. Engulf: The cube moves up to its speed, entering creatures' spaces. Creatures must make a DC 12 Dexterity save or be engulfed, taking 10 (3d6) acid damage.
actions: Pseudopod: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.
description: Gelatinous cubes are mindless oozes that scour dungeon corridors clean.

name: Mimic
special_abilities: Shapechanger: The mimic can polymorph into an object or back. Adhesive (Object Form): The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. False Appearance (Object Form): Indistinguishable from an ordinary object. Grappler: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.
actions: Pseudopod: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning plus 4 (1d8) acid. Bite: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing plus 4 (1d8) acid.
description: Mimics are shape-shifting monsters that disguise themselves as objects.

name: Ankylosaurus
actions: Tail: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6+4) bludgeoning. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
description: Ankylosaurus is a heavily armored herbivorous dinosaur.

name: Bandit Captain
actions: Multiattack: The captain makes three attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Scimitar: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 6 (1d6+3) slashing. Dagger: +5 to hit, 5 ft. or 20/60 ft., Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing.
description: Bandit captains are experienced leaders of criminal gangs.

name: Berserker
special_abilities: Reckless: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee attacks until the start of its next turn, but attacks against it have advantage.
actions: Greataxe: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing.
description: Berserkers are fearsome warriors driven by battle fury.

name: Ogre
actions: Greatclub: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning. Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing.
description: Ogres are hulking, brutish giants driven by hunger and greed.

name: Griffon
special_abilities: Keen Sight: The griffon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
actions: Multiattack: The griffon makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws. Beak: +6 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing. Claws: +6 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing.
description: Griffons are majestic creatures with the body of a lion and head of an eagle.

name: Swarm of Poisonous Snakes
condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned
special_abilities: Swarm: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake.
actions: Bites: +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison.
description: A swarm of poisonous snakes is a writhing mass of serpents.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, necrotic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
special_abilities: Consume Life: As a bonus action, the will-o'-wisp can target one creature with 0 HP within 30 ft. and kill it, gaining 10 temporary HP. Ephemeral: The will-o'-wisp can't wear or carry anything. Incorporeal Movement: Can move through other creatures and objects. Variable Illumination: The will-o'-wisp sheds bright light in a 5-20 ft. radius.
actions: Shock: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
description: Will-o'-wisps are malevolent balls of light that lure travelers to their doom.

name: Hell Hound
special_abilities: Keen Hearing and Smell: The hell hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell. Pack Tactics: Advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 ft.
actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6): 15-ft. cone, DC 12 Dex save, 21 (6d6) fire damage.
description: Hell hounds are fiery canines from the lower planes.

name: Basilisk
special_abilities: Petrifying Gaze: If a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. of the basilisk and the two can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the save at the end of its next turn. On a success the effect ends. On a failure the creature is petrified until freed by greater restoration or similar magic.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison.
description: Basilisks are reptilian monsters whose gaze can turn creatures to stone.

name: Wight
damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not silvered
special_abilities: Sunlight Sensitivity: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.
actions: Longsword: +4 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 6 (1d8+2) slashing plus 6 (1d12) necrotic. Longbow: +4 to hit, 150/600 ft., Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing plus 6 (1d12) necrotic. Life Drain (Recharge 5-6): +4 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 8 (1d10+3) necrotic, target must make DC 13 Constitution save or its max HP is reduced.
description: Wights are undead remains of warriors driven by hate.

name: Mummy
actions: Multiattack: The mummy makes two attacks with its rotting fist. Rotting Fist: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 10 (2d6+3) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) necrotic. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution save or be cursed with mummy rot.
description: Mummies are undead preserved corpses animated by dark rituals.

name: Owlbear
special_abilities: Keen Sight and Smell: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.
actions: Multiattack: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws. Beak: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 10 (1d10+5) piercing. Claws: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing.
description: Owlbears are savage, ill-tempered hybrids of owls and bears.

name: Veteran
actions: Multiattack: The veteran makes two longsword attacks and one shortsword attack. Longsword: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing. Shortsword: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing.
description: Veterans are experienced soldiers hardened by battle.

name: Displacer Beast
special_abilities: Displacement: The displacer beast projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage.
actions: Multiattack: The displacer beast makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite. Tentacles: +6 to hit, 10 ft., Hit: 7 (1d6+4) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) piercing. Bite: +6 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing.
description: Displacer beasts are magical feline predators that appear to be somewhere else.

name: Winter Wolf
special_abilities: Keen Hearing and Smell: Advantage on Perception checks relying on hearing or smell. Pack Tactics: Advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5 ft. Snow Camouflage: The winter wolf has advantage on Stealth checks in snowy terrain.
actions: Bite: +5 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing plus 4 (1d8) cold damage. Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6): 15-ft. cone, DC 12 Con save, 18 (4d8) cold damage.
description: Winter wolves are intelligent white-furred wolves with cold breath.

name: Ettin
special_abilities: Two Heads: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.
actions: Multiattack: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar. Battleaxe: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 14 (2d8+5) slashing. Morningstar: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 14 (2d8+5) piercing.
description: Ettins are two-headed giants that dwell in mountainous regions.

name: Chimera
special_abilities: Multiattack: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its horns, and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite or horns.
actions: Bite: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing plus 4 (1d8) fire. Horns: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 10 (1d12+4) bludgeoning. Claws: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing. Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6): 15-ft. cone, DC 15 Dex save, 31 (7d8) fire damage.
description: Chimeras are monstrous hybrids of lion, goat, and dragon.

name: Mind Flayer
skills: Arcana +7, Deception +6, Insight +6, Perception +6, Persuasion +6, Stealth +4
special_abilities: Magic Resistance: The mind flayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects. Innate Spellcasting (Psionics): At will: detect thoughts, levitate. 1/day each: dominate monster, plane shift (self only).
actions: Tentacles: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 15 (2d10+4) psychic damage. If target is Medium or smaller, grappled (escape DC 15) and must succeed on DC 15 Int save or be stunned until grapple ends. Extract Brain: +7 to hit, 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid grappled. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing. If this reduces to 0 HP, the mind flayer kills by extracting its brain. Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6): 60-ft. cone, DC 15 Int save, 22 (4d8+4) psychic and stunned 1 minute.
description: Mind flayers are horrifying psychic predators that feed on brains.

name: Beholder
condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, prone, stunned
special_abilities: Antimagic Cone: The beholder's central eye creates a 150-ft. cone of antimagic. Legendary Resistance (3/Day): If the beholder fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
actions: Multiattack: The beholder makes three eye ray attacks. Eye Rays: The beholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates): 1. Charm Ray (DC 17 Wis) 2. Paralyzing Ray (DC 17 Con) 3. Fear Ray (DC 17 Wis) 4. Slowing Ray (DC 17 Dex) 5. Enervation Ray (DC 17 Con, 36 (8d8) necrotic) 6. Telekinetic Ray (DC 17 Str) 7. Sleep Ray (DC 17 Wis) 8. Petrification Ray (DC 17 Dex) 9. Disintegration Ray (DC 17 Dex, 45 (10d8) force) 10. Death Ray (DC 17 Dex, 55 (10d10) necrotic). Legendary Actions: 3 actions, uses eye rays.
description: Beholders are tentacled, spherical aberrations driven by paranoia.

name: Young Red Dragon
special_abilities: Multiattack: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
actions: Bite: +10 to hit, 10 ft., Hit: 17 (2d10+6) piercing plus 3 (1d6) fire. Claw: +10 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 13 (2d6+6) slashing. Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6): 30-ft. cone, DC 17 Dex save, 56 (16d6) fire damage.
description: Young red dragons are fiercely aggressive and covetous.

name: Adult Red Dragon
saves: STR +14, DEX +6, CON +13, INT +9, WIS +7, CHA +11
special_abilities: Legendary Resistance (3/Day): If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Multiattack: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
actions: Bite: +14 to hit, 10 ft., Hit: 19 (2d10+8) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire. Claw: +14 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 15 (2d6+8) slashing. Tail: +14 to hit, 15 ft., Hit: 17 (2d8+8) bludgeoning. name: Spectator
actions: Bite: +1 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing. Eye Rays: The spectator shoots two of the following eye rays at random: 1. Paralyzing Ray (DC 13 Con) 2. Fear Ray (DC 13 Wis) 3. Sleep Ray (DC 13 Wis) 4. Wounding Ray (DC 13 Con, 18 (4d8) necrotic).
description: Spectators are lesser beholders summoned to guard treasures.

name: Troll
special_abilities: Keen Smell: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. Regeneration: The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function on its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.
actions: Multiattack: The troll makes two attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. Bite: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 7 (1d6+4) piercing. Claw: +7 to hit, 5 ft., Hit: 11 (2d6+4) slashing.
description: Trolls are lanky, regenerative giants with a voracious appetite.
